title: Fail-mode spotlight cards for onboarding quickstart
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Purpose: Create a set of lightweight, visually distinct ‘Fail-mode Spotlight’ microcards and annotated screenshots to surface during the first-run quickstart and docs for common transient errors (rate limits, request timeouts, and retry behavior). These assets will be used in: the quickstart toolbar, the onboarding modal, docs troubleshooting pages, and the Console's first-run diagnostics panel.

Scope:
- 6 microcards (3 error types × 2 severity levels): Rate Limit - Soft, Rate Limit - Hard; Timeout - Short, Timeout - Long; Retry - Auto, Retry - Exceeded.
- 3 annotated product screenshots showing where the user sees the error and suggested next steps.
- Copy variants for in-product microcopy (short/concise), docs (explanatory), and email/notification text.
- Figma frames with export-ready artboards and redlines for engineering (SVG + PNG 2x).
- Accessibility checklist and i18n notes for localization.

Design goals:
- Be calm and actionable: reduce alarm while giving next steps.
- Minimize cognitive load: 1 primary action + 1 secondary action per card.
- Consistent with Console visual system: spacing, typography, and color tokens.
- Works in both light and dark themes.

Non-goals:
- Not implementing fallback flow logic in runtime. Engineering will consume assets and map them to runtime states.

Localization-ready strings in a CSV with context annotations
Design handoff notes with CSS tokens and export names for engineering
Accessibility checklist completed (contrast, focus order, screen-reader text)
PM review and engineering alignment recorded in comments with links to PR and runtime ticket
